title: Less Is More? Examining Fairness in Pruned Large Language Models for Summarising Opinions

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the proportional representation of left-leaning versus right-leaning opinions in LLM-generated summaries of political tweets compared to the original source documents using metrics like Second-Order Statistical Parity Difference (SPD), Binary Unfair Rate (BUR), and Unfair Error Rate (UER).

Evaluating the balance of positive versus negative sentiments in LLM-generated summaries of product reviews to detect disproportionate representation compared to the balanced source reviews, utilizing fairness metrics such as Second-Order SPD.
